entries.zh: 养育；抚养（供给滋养，使之长大）
entries.en: to sustain, nourish; to raise, bring up (children)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「富」与词义不合（疑误录），音写首音 hieg 亦难确指；据西语 sustentar, criar 与尾音 iang≈養 判为养育。

entries.zh: 供养；赡养（西语原例指供养天父）
entries.en: to sustain, uphold; to provide for (example: to sustain God the Father)
entries.notes: 汉字「賡」（赓续）与音写 siam（赡）不尽相合，西语例指供养天父，取供养/赡养义，存疑。

entries.en: to resist, withstand; to hold out against the enemy
to raise and feed (the young, offspring); to rear
to supply, provide for; to sustain and nourish (the young)
to provide for one's aged parents; to support the old
entries.notes: 西语「sustentar a dios P.re」中 dios 与汉字「赡老」不合（疑邻条误连），据「赡老」判为赡养老人。

entries.en: to keep up, maintain a household; to support the family

entries.zh: 供膳；供给饮食（子奉养父、弟子奉养师）
entries.en: to provide food for, board; to support (a son his father, or a disciple his master)

entries.zh: 保命；保全性命（维持生命）
entries.en: to keep alive, sustain life; to preserve one's life
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺（[残]）且音写首音污损（T99），汉字「捍命」疑为「活命」之误认，据西语 sustentar la vida 判为维持生命，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 养成；养育成人（扶养至立业）
entries.en: to bring up, raise to maturity; to sustain until one is established (in life)
nourishment, sustenance (of animals); to rear, breed
to raise and nurture (young animals); rearing, sustenance of animals
fine, delicate; a small, fine thing
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（[疑:灣/瀾]）且均与音写 poj 不合，释义仅据西语 sutil cosa pequeña 判定。

entries.en: minute, tiny, subtle; a fine small thing

entries.zh: 玄微；精微玄妙（纤细之理与物）
entries.en: profoundly subtle, mysteriously fine; fine and minute
entries.notes: 音写另录 suy suy（疑为「細細」之纤细义），与「玄微」并注。

entries.zh: 原；本有之物（自身天然固有的）
entries.en: one's own, native; original (what is proper to its nature)
his, of that one; belonging to him
entries.notes: 音写栏附残损片段（[残]），可读部分 hu ge＝許个，与西语 suyo de aquel 相合。
